name: The Grand Lighter
//: Story Phase 16: THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND LIGHTER OF GRAND SMOKES (Cheap-O-Rama; Cheapy the Cheapskate Clown on the box). A story item with a malfunction profile (data/story/novelty.json): working, not reliable. Used in scenes; obviously fictional; nothing about it is a real device.
description: THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND LIGHTER OF GRAND SMOKES. Purple and gold plastic, printed crooked. 'NOW WITH GRANDNESS!' Attempts so far: {num:lighter_clicks}. Flames so far: some.

variants.description: THE GRAND LIGHTER. Unreliable, cheap, ridiculous, and the only thing that kept Vindicta from lighting a cigarette with the Crew Quarters. Attempts: {num:lighter_clicks}. You'd buy another.

name: Employee Visor
description: A purple employee visor: THE GRAND DISPENSARY. HELLO! I'M HAPPY TO SERVE YOU. You were hired against your will. It's still on.

variants.description: A purple visor, the word DISPENSARY scratched out and GRAND BANK written over it in Bankworth's hand. Still HAPPY TO SERVE YOU.

name: Converter Receipt
description: GRAND CURRENCY CONVERSION. INPUT: 1 GRAND TOKEN. OUTPUT: 1 COFFIN SOCK ATMOSPHERIC EQUIVALENT (DELIVERED). FEE: 1 GRAND TOKEN. THANK YOU FOR CONVERTING.
